qa_pairs.instruction: Why is an initial data migration required when adding the Integration module to an Identity Vault that already contains user objects, in the context of the Sentinel Identity Tracking driver?
qa_pairs.output: When you add the Integration module of the Sentinel Identity Tracking driver to an Identity Vault that already holds user objects and associated data, the existing Vault data must be transferred into Sentinel so that Sentinel can start tracking those identities. The initial migration ensures that all current identity information is available in Sentinel, enabling the driver to manage and synchronize identities correctly after the integration.

qa_pairs.instruction: How can you accelerate the migration of Identity Vault data into Sentinel when the target Sentinel system contains no prior identity data, using the Sentinel Identity Tracking driver?
qa_pairs.output: To speed up the migration with the Sentinel Identity Tracking driver when the destination Sentinel system has no existing identity data, you should disable the Subscriber channel matching policies before starting the migration. Disabling these policies reduces processing overhead, allowing the migration to complete more quickly.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the preparatory steps recommended before migrating Identity Vault data into Sentinel with the Sentinel Identity Tracking driver.
qa_pairs.output: Before migrating Identity Vault data into Sentinel using the Sentinel Identity Tracking driver, you need to: 1) Perform an initial migration of all existing user objects and data from the Identity Vault into Sentinel; and 2) If the target Sentinel system is empty, disable the Subscriber channel matching policies to speed up the migration process.
